issues.description: The exercise, template, and solution use inconsistent endpoint naming for the same resource: the problem statement requires endpoints under /persons, the solution's server exposes endpoints under /people, while the client in the solution uses /persons. This mismatch (persons vs people) will prevent client-server communication and contradicts the API specified in the problem statement, causing confusion and runtime failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the resource path naming across problem statement, server and client. Prefer using /persons to match the problem description: update the server mappings in PersonResource to use "persons" (e.g. @GetMapping("persons"), @PostMapping("persons"), etc.), or alternatively update the client and the problem text consistently to "people". Ensure both client and server use the exact same paths so requests succeed.
